Overview

Sunshine Coast is a city in Queensland with a population of 375,498. Queensland’s coastal paradise with stunning beaches, national parks, and a relaxed lifestyle. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 275 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
